doctrines.note: Veterancy: Full Top. Hero pairing: Any. "Filler" doctrine section is a literal X placeholder in the OP -- not fabricated here. "Don't put": DMG reduction like the -5% one, per Amya you're getting one-shot anyway. Playstyle kit: go with frontline; most of the time press 1 then quickly press 2; when cooldowns reset, spam 1 and 2 again (killing enemies resets cooldowns); if fighting a heavy armor unit, let skill 1 land its hit first to apply the armor debuff, then resume spamming 1 and 2; be careful about not over-extending, sometimes better to X-move back before pressing 1-2 once more. Example build per OP: Unit Damage Doctrine V, Toughness Doctrine (-33% dmg taken first 8 hits), Wuwei Unique Doctrine (Brutal Sweep +10% HP), Epic Combat Doctrine (3/6/9), Siege Fighter Doctrine. "Origin" is a literal X placeholder in the OP -- not fabricated here. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset -- WuWei is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).

steps.text: Go with frontline; most of the time press 1, then quickly press 2.
When cooldowns reset, spam 1 and 2 again -- killing enemies resets cooldowns.
Let skill 1 land its hit first to apply the armor debuff, then resume spamming 1 and 2.
Be careful about not over-extending; sometimes it's better to X-move back before pressing 1-2 once more.
